# Lucid Research — CS Conference Deadline Tracker

> A free, daily-refreshed tracker of submission deadlines for 185+ top computer
> science conferences across nine research areas. Built and maintained by
> Madhava Gaikwad.

The interactive dashboard runs on Streamlit; a static landing page provides a
crawlable description. Deadline data is aggregated daily from open,
community-maintained sources plus a curated manual list, and is openly
downloadable as JSON.

## Coverage

- 185+ conferences; 9 areas: theory, security & privacy, distributed systems,
  networking, systems & architecture, databases, software engineering / PL,
  AI / ML, biomedical computing.
- Per conference: next submission deadline, abstract deadline, dates, location,
  CORE/CCF rank, and source.

## Links

- Live tracker: https://paper-tracker-madhava.streamlit.app/
- Landing page: https://krimler.github.io/paper-tracker/
- Source code: https://github.com/krimler/paper-tracker
- Data (JSON): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krimler/paper-tracker/main/data/conferences.json

## Data sources

ccfddl/ccf-deadlines (primary), paperswithcode/ai-deadlines,
sec-deadlines.github.io, tcs-conf.github.io, and a curated manual list.

## AI usage preferences (IETF AIPREF)

- Search & indexing: allowed.
- AI inference / answers: allowed — you may read and cite this content.
- AI model training (incl. generative): not consented to.

Normative signals are in https://krimler.github.io/paper-tracker/robots.txt
(Content-Usage).
